Func - VarMan VI Error Cluster to Func Result Value.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

This VI converts an error returned by a VarMan VI to the value returned by a FuncVI function.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

VarMan VI error in can accept error information wired from a VarMan VI previously called.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
CE Function Result Value returns a VarMan Engine error code if VarMan VI error in signals an error. This terminal can be wired directly to the num member in the result cluster of a FuncVI.

 

Func - VarMan VI Error Cluster to Func Result Value.vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
